name: Care Plans
headline: We maintain it. *You own it.*
promise: Websites decay quietly — dependencies age, content goes stale, and one missed update can take a good site down. Care Plans keep yours fast, secure and current: updates shipped, backups running, changes made, analytics reviewed with you every month. And because you own everything — code, domain, data — you stay because it works, not because you're stuck.

included.title: Content changes
included.text: New prices, new photos, a new team member, this week's offer. Send it on WhatsApp and it goes live — no ticket portals, no waiting rooms.

included.title: Updates & patches
included.text: Frameworks, dependencies and integrations kept current. Everything is tested before it touches production, so updates land quietly instead of loudly.

included.title: Daily offsite backups
included.text: Automatic backups stored away from your hosting, with fast restore. If something ever breaks, we roll back — we don't panic.

included.title: Security monitoring
included.text: Uptime checks, SSL renewal, dependency alerts and scans running around the clock. Most problems get fixed before you'd ever notice them.

included.title: Monthly analytics review call
included.text: Thirty minutes on what your dashboard actually says — visitors, sources, funnels, drop-offs. You leave each call with one or two concrete next moves.

included.title: Performance guardrails
included.text: We defend your 90+ Lighthouse targets as content grows. Speed is a habit, not a launch-day trick.

process.text: We take the keys — or set up access to a site we didn't build — run a full health check, and record the baseline for speed, security and SEO.
Backups scheduled, monitoring wired up, pending updates applied. From here your site is watched around the clock.
Content changes ship as you send them. Patches and updates land in the background. You run your business; the site keeps pace.
We open your analytics together, agree what to improve next, and do it. Cancel anytime — everything you own keeps working without us.

faqs.a: No — that's the whole point. You own the code, the repository, the domain and your analytics data from day one. Cancel any month and everything keeps working; you just lose the crew maintaining it.

faqs.q: Do you take on sites SiteBlitz didn't build?
faqs.a: Yes, after a quick technical audit. If your site runs on a stack we can maintain properly, we onboard it and treat it like one of ours. If it doesn't, we'll say so plainly and suggest what makes sense instead.

faqs.q: What counts as a content change?
faqs.a: The everyday stuff: text edits, price updates, new photos, team changes, swapping an offer or announcement. Whole new pages or features are scoped and quoted separately, so there are never surprise invoices.

faqs.q: What happens on the monthly review call?
faqs.a: We read your first-party analytics dashboard together — visitors, sources, funnels, what changed since last month. Then we pick one or two concrete improvements and ship them. It's the difference between having data and using it.

faqs.q: My site already works. Why would I need this?
faqs.a: Because websites decay quietly. Dependencies age, security holes appear, content goes stale — and both Google and your customers notice. A monthly habit at ₹2,499 is far cheaper than an emergency rebuild.

cta: Hand over the maintenance. Never the ownership.
